record.reason: This paper studies how language models integrate evidence while spending extra inference-time computation, using sequential counting experiments and reasoning-token measures. Its scope is analysis of reasoning behavior, not a proposed method to lower inference resource use; it also cautions that reasoning-token count is distinct from FLOPs/latency and that task experience/feedback/context co-vary.
record.title: Counting on Thinking: Tracing Evidence Integration in Language Models
